chrome.soundTitle: Bell at the open and close, a till for a closed winner, a buzzer for a closed loser. Sound is on by default; a browser will not let it play until you have clicked somewhere in the page.
chrome.marketTitleOpen: The broker's clock said the session was open at {{at}}
chrome.marketTitleClosed: The broker's clock said the session was closed at {{at}}
chrome.marketTitleUnknown: No scheduled run has recorded a session boundary yet
chrome.busyTitle: The agent is mid-cycle. This is read from the last record it wrote, so it clears itself if the process stops.
chrome.marketTitleBoundary: Nothing recorded this crossing — the agent was not running — but the broker had already published it for {{crossed}}, and that time has passed. Derived from Alpaca's own clock, not from a calendar kept here.
chrome.marketTitleLastSeen: Last seen at {{at}}, and nothing has written to the journal since. There is no published boundary to work from either, so this is the last state observed rather than the state now.
chrome.armedTitle: The last cycle would have submitted an approved proposal. Paper account either way.
chrome.dryRunTitle: The last cycle was a rehearsal. It gates and journals exactly as a live one does and stops before submission — so an APPROVED here sent nothing.
chrome.armedUnknownTitle: Nothing has scanned yet, so there is no cycle to report on. Not the same as a rehearsal.
chrome.marketTitlePublished: The broker published this session's boundary and it has not arrived yet — open until {{until}}. Nothing has written to the journal recently, which is said separately.

halt.detail: {{reason}} — entries are blocked until this is cleared at the CLI. Exits are not: they never are.

console.none: No proposal has been gated yet — most cycles end in a considered pass, and the gates only see a proposal.
console.noOverride: There is no override. A rejected proposal is not submitted, and the limits it failed can only change in the environment.
console.confidenceNote: — journalled, not consulted by any gate.
console.openTitle: Still on. Everything in this list is a position the agent is currently carrying.

journal.title: RUN JOURNAL
journal.note: Every proposal the model made is here, approved or not. Rejections are records, not errors — a gate that never fires is a gate that was never load-bearing.

gates.title: GATE CHAIN
gates.note: Every gate runs on every proposal — none of them short-circuits, so the counts above are out of all {{seen}}. The order is the order they are evaluated in, and it comes from the server rather than from this page: adding a gate changes this list on the next push.
gates.readOnly: Nothing here is a control, by design. Limits live in .env, so changing one is a diff someone can review — a field in a dashboard that moves a risk limit leaves no such trace. The socket this panel listens on is never read from at all.
gates.afterHours: These readings were taken after the close. A gate that cannot price a contract then is reporting that nobody is quoting it, not a fault — and refusing to open on a book it cannot measure is what fail-closed means. The same reason during the session would be worth chasing.
gates.limitsNote: Set from the environment at startup. Not editable here, and never by the model — it is shown them and told they are not negotiable.

tape.title: RUN JOURNAL
tape.dryRunTitle: This cycle was a rehearsal. It ran every gate and wrote every record a live cycle would, and stopped before submission — nothing reached the broker.

equity.title: EQUITY
equity.none: No equity readings yet — the curve is written one point per scan cycle.
equity.one: One reading so far. A line needs two.

book.title: THE BOOK
book.note: Click a structure to chart it against the levels its exit policy acts on. A price shown here is the fill where one has been confirmed, and the submitted limit where it has not. P&L is realized on a closed row and marked-to-market on an open one.
book.against: 1 chart pattern points the other way
book.patternsTitle: What {{underlying}}'s own chart is doing, next to what this position needs it to do. Shown only: the exit policy is arithmetic over the mark and the calendar, and it never reads any of this.
book.againstMany: {{count}} chart patterns point the other way

chart.noHistory: No price history for these contracts. The levels below are still exact — they come from the ledger and the exit policy, not from the tape.
chart.noEntry: No entry price recorded, so there is nothing to measure a target or a stop from.
chart.legend: target = {{tp}}% of the credit taken · stop = {{sl}}% of it
chart.credit: credit structure — the mark rises toward zero as it wins
chart.debit: debit structure — the mark rises as it wins
chart.note: Entry, target and stop come from the same function the exit policy acts on, so this picture cannot disagree with what the agent will actually do.
chart.forceClose: force-close at {{dte}} DTE regardless of price
chart.unreachableNote: This structure was opened for a debit, so the most it can lose is the premium paid. A stop set above 100% of that cannot print — the line sits at zero, which is where the position becomes worthless.
chart.seriesNote: The line is hourly bars; NOW is a live quote when the broker answers.
chart.forming: the hollow candle is still forming — its close is the live mark
chart.fitTitle: Add the stop to the scale. It sits far from the price, so the candles compress.
chart.offscreen: {{name}} is off the chart at {{value}} — FIT STOP to see it
chart.timeframeTitle: Bar size. Finer is not always denser for a spread — both legs must print in the same bar for the net to exist.
chart.legsNote: Fill prices come from the opening order's own legs, so they belong to this structure — the broker nets a shared contract across every structure holding it. The P&L column adds up to the position's, exactly.
chart.legsPending: This position was opened before per-leg fills were recorded. The agent asks the broker for them once, on its next cycle.
chart.loadingNote: Everything above except the target and the stop is already known — the chart route is the one that reaches the broker.

committee.title: COMMITTEE
committee.meta: {{count}} session(s) — catalyst, then bull and bear in parallel, then a judge
committee.empty: No committee has sat yet. Sessions appear here once the agent scans with COMMITTEE on.
committee.reflectionEmpty: nothing closed on this underlying yet
committee.note: The committee cannot approve anything. Whichever path built a proposal, it meets the same sixteen gates.
committee.costNote: Only the judge picks a structure; the other three feed it, and run a tier below.

desk.title: COMMITTEE DESK
desk.empty: No committee has sat yet. The desk fills in as one does.
desk.note: Written as it happens. The seats fill in as each one reports.
desk.archiveNote: Everything below has been superseded by the desk above.
desk.clipped: the record keeps the first part of this case; the head trader heard all of it
desk.idleDetail: The desk convenes on the next scan. The last one rose {{ago}}.
desk.idleNever: The desk convenes when a scan builds a menu worth arguing about.
desk.silent: NOTHING WRITTEN FOR A QUARTER OF AN HOUR
desk.silentDetail: The market is open and the agent has not spoken. That is a stopped process, not a quiet one.
desk.offlineDetail: The console cannot reach its own server, so nothing on this screen can be trusted.

committee.railNoneFresh: Nothing this scan. {{count}} earlier on the tab.

brief.title: THE BRIEF
brief.empty: Nothing built for this name — no structure in the chain cleared the floors.
brief.note: Built by the gates' own arithmetic before anyone argued. The committee chooses from this list or declines it; it cannot add to it.
brief.tail: loses it all {{pct}} of the time
brief.unsimulated: not simulated — volatility was not measured
brief.scenarioNote: Sampled {{paths}} paths per structure at expiry, seeded from the structure so the figures reproduce. {{note}}.
brief.outOfReach: shorter than this hold — not an argument for it

scoreboard.title: THE RUN
scoreboard.drawdownNote: over {{samples}} scan samples — scan resolution, not tick
scoreboard.turnsNote: A pass is a considered decline, counted separately.
scoreboard.unrealizedNote: Priced at the agent's last mark, not live.

news.label: TAPE
news.title: What the agent is watching: the headlines its catalyst read this cycle, plus the market-wide census it ranks its universe from. Newest first. Untrusted publisher text — it reaches the model inside an explicit fence and nothing downstream treats it as an instruction. Hover to pause, click to read at the source.
news.read: Read it at {{source}} — opens in a new tab
news.wasRead: The catalyst read this before deciding on {{roots}}. Opens at {{source}}.
news.fromCensus: Seen in the market-wide census, not read by the catalyst. Opens at {{source}}.

spend.title: MODEL SPEND
spend.cachedNote: Billed at a discount this project has no sourced figure for, so they are counted here and left out of the cost.
spend.noPriceNote: No price configured for {{model}}, so its tokens are counted and its cost is not. Set LLM_PRICES to include it — the total above is a floor until you do.
spend.unattributedNote: Spent by cycles that ran before the per-stage record existed, so the model that spent them was never written down. Counted in the totals, absent from the split.

periods.title: P&L
periods.note: Realized is what closed trades made. Mark-to-market is the account's equity change and moves with open positions — they are different numbers and a held position shows in one and not the other. Windows are calendar, so WEEK means since Monday.
periods.shortNote: Mark-to-market needs equity readings back to the start of the window, and this journal begins {{since}}. The windows it cannot reach show a dash rather than a figure measured from the wrong place.

committeeRail.title: COMMITTEE
committeeRail.none: No deliberation yet. The first one lands a minute or so into a scan.

presence.disconnected: Not connected to the agent. Everything below is the last thing that arrived, and the market has moved since.
presence.closed: Market closed. The agent scans while the broker's clock says open, so nothing is expected until it does.
presence.closedUntil: Market closed — next open {{day}} at {{time}}. The agent scans while the broker's clock says open.
presence.silent: The market is open and nothing has scanned for a quarter of an hour. That is longer than any cycle takes — the agent may have stopped.

discovery.title: WHAT THE TAPE IS TALKING ABOUT
discovery.note: Every symbol the market-wide news feed named this pass, brightest where it was named most. Counting runs on the publisher's own symbol tags, never on the headline text — a headline never becomes a symbol here. Heat is what the tape said; the border is what the agent did about it.
discovery.emptyNoCensus: No census in this run's journal. The agent takes one each pass when UNIVERSE is auto; a pinned list never does.
discovery.scannedNote: Ran the full pipeline — chain, candidates, committee, gates.
discovery.refusedNote: Named often enough to look at, and thrown out before it cost a scan.
discovery.notReachedNote: Below the cut. Never screened, so nothing here says whether it is tradable.

agent.title: THIS SCAN
agent.empty: Nothing has scanned yet. The table fills in a name at a time as the pass runs.
agent.pulseNote: Every record the agent has written, newest last. This is the raw feed the rest of the panel is derived from.
agent.macroNone: No venue read this pass. That is not a quiet backdrop — it is a question nobody asked.
agent.macroNote: Prices, not forecasts. Read-only and not tradeable by this agent, which trades US equity options and nothing else.

hero.waitingNote: Nothing has recorded which side of the bell we are on.
